notes: Attempt 3 of 3. Attempt 1 floated the trim across the middle of the cuff face as a burgundy ribbon with plain white cloth outside it - the option was not readable and that was a critical placement failure. Attempt 2 moved the trim onto the hem and closing edges but kept the drawing's notation red and left one arm floating. Attempt 3 binds the actual cloth edge in navy with the mitred corner and is the best of the three. The drawing is a 3/4 view of an isolated cuff drum whose axis runs left-right in the image: the drawn long horizontal arm is the closing edge (running across the band height) and the vertical arm is the hem edge (running around the wrist), joined at the mitred corner. That reading is what attempt 3 renders. Residual uncertainty is dimensional only - I could not resolve the 0.6 cm trim width at this resolution and I am not asserting it.
